notes.title: New game and bundles released
notes.content:
Shine's Adventures 6 (Go! Girls) was officially released. If you have "ShineG In Bumpercat", please check the collection rules on the store page.

And I set up a bundle of Shine's Adventures for everyone now.If you like this series, the bundle will give you more discounts.

Here is the link to the bundle.
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/12728/Shines_Adventures/

The bundle includes Shine's Adventures 2 (Zombie Attack) and Shine's Adventures 6 (Go! Girls). The latter one was released just now.

store.steampowered.com/app/1105410/Shines_Adventures_2_Zombie_Attack/
